_comment: Stop-hook output checks. Each rule is a regex tested against the agent's final assistant message. On a match the stop is blocked with the rule's message so the agent rewrites. Ships mostly disabled: turn on what your owner actually wants. Add your own by appending an entry. 'pattern' is a Python regex; keep it anchored and cheap.

rules.name: em_dash
rules.message: Your final message contains an em-dash. This owner bans them. Rewrite using a period, comma, or 'and' instead, then stop.

rules.name: unsourced_long_quote
rules.message: Your final message contains a long quoted passage (60+ characters). If this is a real quote, name its source inline. If it is a paraphrase, drop the quote marks. Then stop.

rules.name: hedge_stack
rules.message: Your final message stacks three or more hedging words in one sentence (might/perhaps/possibly/maybe). Commit to a claim or name the specific uncertainty, then stop.
